create_OPENAI_llm_client: create an OPENAI LLM client with a model and API key to query GPT models
create_ANYSCALE_llm_client: create an ANYSCALE LLM client with a model and API key to query Llama or Mistral models
query_OPENAI_with_prompt: query the OPENAI LLM client with a prompt string and get the model response
query_with_system_prompt: query an LLM client with both a system prompt and user prompt for context-aware responses
query_with_retries: query an LLM client with automatic retries and exponential backoff on failure
